_note: Walking on a trodden hoe path (Dave 3 Nov 2026): the pace is multiplied by these while the player stands on a path patch. Tune here. A path patch counts when its centre is in the same 1 m ground cell as the player or the next one over, so the strong middle (1 m across) and its soft edge both count. Run gets no bonus on purpose: paths pay off for the everyday walk and jog (hauling, travelling between camp and water).
